program.name: Legs All Over
program.subject: Legs & glutes
program.blurb: Every part of the legs: quads and calves, glutes and inner thighs, then the upper body.
program.about: Legs from every angle, including the parts most programs skip. One day is quads and calves; the next is glutes and inner thighs; the third trains the upper body. The calf and adductor work make the legs stronger and the knees and ankles steadier. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for heavier weights.
